methods.series: Three alternating forward/reverse-order fresh sequential processes per host. Parse and diagnostics included; imports excluded. Peak whole-process RSS. No overlapping work from this task on the same host. Mac load varied considerably; absolute times are not an unloaded-machine promise.
methods.intel: Verified x86_64 and Node 24.15.0 at SSH port 22022 root@viewflow.io, /tmp/rank401-20261104; series survived SSH disconnect, complete JSONL fetched.
methods.hand: One exploratory run per host, BigInt formula only, no Rank startup, demand, type, cancellation or location contracts; not an equivalent-runtime lower-bound proof.
methods.initialProbes: Earlier single exploratory runs, do not combine their timings with the controlled series. shared probes use one array read rather than three; not a repeated measurement.
methods.diagnostics: Only nonzero counters; duplicate fallback categories omitted, nonzero cost fields preserved.
